# llms.txt - Guidance for AI and LLM Crawlers for Amerus Financial
# Reference: emerging community conventions for AI crawler governance.
# This file is complementary to robots.txt and provides machine-readable
# directives for Large Language Model (LLM) indexers.

# Site identity
site: https://www.amerusfinancial.com
owner: Amerus Financial
contact: support@amerusfinancial.com
last-updated: 2025-11-12

# Licensing & Usage
# Content (articles, service descriptions) is protected by copyright. You
# may index snippets for search but MUST NOT reproduce full articles.
license: CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0-excerpt-only
copyright-notice: Copyright (c) 2025 Amerus Financial. All rights reserved.

# Allowed Purposes
allow-purpose: search
allow-purpose: summarization
allow-purpose: snippet-generation (<= 500 characters)

# Disallowed Purposes
disallow-purpose: full-article-replication
disallow-purpose: commercial-redistribution
disallow-purpose: training-on-private-user-data

# Rate Limits (suggested)
rate-limit: 100 requests / 24h

# Content Scope
allow-path: /articles/
allow-path: /services/
allow-path: /about-us
allow-path: /contact

# Sensitive or dynamic endpoints should be excluded
disallow-path: /api/
disallow-path: /server/

# Attribution Requirement
attribution-required: true
attribution-format: "Source: Amerus Financial (https://www.amerusfinancial.com)"

# Derivative Works
derivative-works: prohibited

# Model Training
model-training: restricted
training-restriction-detail: "Only publicly available, non-personal, short-form excerpts may be used."

# Request for Removal
takedown-contact: legal@amerusfinancial.com

# Additional Notes
note: This llms.txt is an experimental policy document. LLM providers should honor both robots.txt and this file.
